title: TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF USE
intro: This document regulates access to and use of the College by Hericraft & College Store digital ecosystem. By accepting, the USER agrees to the provisions contained herein.

sections.intro: I. INTRODUCTION TO THE DIGITAL ECOSYSTEM
sections.objeto: II. PURPOSE AND ACCEPTANCE OF THE CONTRACT
sections.menores: III. ELIGIBILITY AND PROTECTION OF MINORS
sections.responsabilidad: VII. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY AND WARRANTIES

intro_naturaleza_texto:
This document constitutes a binding adhesion contract that regulates access to and use of the unified technological environment called "Hericraft Digital Ecosystem" (hereinafter, the ECOSYSTEM). This ecosystem is integrated indivisibly but functionally differentiated by:

1. College by Hericraft: A virtual learning environment (VLE) operated under the Software as a Service (SaaS) model, focused on pedagogical management and the development of SNAP competencies in Education 5.0.
2. College Store: An e-commerce unit intended for the offering, sale and distribution of tangible and intangible goods related to the educational model.

By accessing any of these units, the USER acknowledges that the legal relationship is governed by the commercial and civil laws of the State of Aguascalientes and the international e-commerce treaties ratified by Mexico.
intro_declaraciones_texto: Hericraft Soluciones Integrales en Educación 4.0 declares itself to be a legally constituted entity under Mexican laws, with the technical and legal capacity to manage high‑complexity digital assets. The RESPONSIBLE PARTY states that the ECOSYSTEM operates under the principles of digital sovereignty, ensuring that data processing and the execution of artificial intelligence algorithms are carried out under ethical and transparency standards.
intro_consentimiento_texto: For 2026, consent is not a mere formality but an act of express will. THE USER expresses their agreement through the following actions of tacit and express acceptance:
intro_consentimiento_item2: Interaction with the navigation artificial intelligence.
intro_consentimiento_item3: Use of 'Single Sign‑On' (SSO) protocols to move between the educational platform and the store.
intro_consentimiento_nota: Legal note: Clicking the 'I accept the Terms and Conditions' button has the same legal validity as a handwritten signature, in accordance with the Mexican Commerce Code regarding Electronic Signatures and Data Messages.
intro_interoperabilidad_texto: The USER acknowledges that the ECOSYSTEM operates under a unique digital identity model. This means that the access credentials created in College by Hericraft are valid and binding for transactions in College Store. This integration allows:
intro_interoperabilidad_item1: Synchronization of educational benefits with commercial benefits (rewards, discounts for academic merit).
intro_interoperabilidad_item2: A consolidated history of interactions that facilitates the exercise of ARCO Rights.
intro_geografico_texto: Although the ECOSYSTEM is accessible from anywhere in the world, the offering of services in College by Hericraft and the sale of products in College Store are designed primarily under the legislation of Mexico and Latin America. Users accessing from outside these regions do so at their own risk and are responsible for complying with their local laws, although legal disputes will be resolved exclusively in the courts of Aguascalientes, Ags.
objeto_multifuncional_texto:
The purpose of this contract is to regulate the legal relationship between the RESPONSIBLE PARTY and the USER, which is divided into two operational aspects that coexist in the Digital Ecosystem:

1. Provision of educational services (SaaS): The granting of a non‑exclusive, temporary, revocable license to access the College by Hericraft platform, including its methodology, learning algorithms (SNAP Core) and pedagogical interaction tools.
2. Intermediation and commercial purchase and sale: The regulation of commercial transactions carried out in College Store, including the acquisition of tangible goods (physical items) and intangible goods (digital assets, certifications, extended licenses).
objeto_clickwrap_texto:
In accordance with the provisions of articles 1803 of the Federal Civil Code and 80 of the Commerce Code, the parties agree that consent is perfected electronically through the Click‑wrap model.

The USER expresses their express consent by clicking the registration or purchase button, acknowledging that they have read, understood and accepted all the clauses presented herein. Access to the freely browsable sections of the ECOSYSTEM also constitutes tacit acceptance of these terms with respect to the use of data and intellectual property.
objeto_capacidad_texto: Adults: By accepting these terms, the user declares that they have sufficient legal capacity to be bound by the terms of this contract.
objeto_capacidad_texto_1: Minors (enhanced protection): In the case of minor users, the contract is understood to be entered into by their parents or legal guardians. THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY reserves the right to implement digital identity verification mechanisms (biometrics or simple electronic signature of the guardian) to validate such representation. Any activity carried out by a minor without proper supervision shall be the sole responsibility of their legal representatives.
objeto_licencia_titulo: 2.4. Nature of the license versus ownership
objeto_licencia_texto:
It is an essential condition of this contract that the USER acknowledges that payment for a subscription or access to College by Hericraft does not constitute a sale of content, but rather a Limited Access license.

Non‑ownership clause: The user does not acquire any intellectual property rights over the code, educational materials, interfaces or AI engines of the ECOSYSTEM. Improper use or extraction of content outside the limits of the license shall be grounds for immediate termination without liability for Hericraft Soluciones Integrales en Educación 4.0 S.A. de C.V.
objeto_modificaciones_titulo: 2.5. Modifications to the contract (right to update)
objeto_modificaciones_texto: Given the evolving nature of Education 5.0 and E‑commerce in 2026, THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY reserves the right to modify the purpose or conditions of this contract.
objeto_modificaciones_texto_1: Notification: Changes will be notified via email or in‑app notices.
objeto_modificaciones_texto_2: Continued acceptance: Use of the services after notification of changes constitutes acceptance of the new conditions. If the user does not agree with the modifications, they must refrain from using the ECOSYSTEM and may request the cancellation of their account in accordance with the ARCO Rights section.
menores_capacidad_texto:
Access to the ECOSYSTEM is conditioned upon the user's legal capacity. For the purposes of these terms, two categories of users are established:

1. Full users: Individuals aged 18 or over with full legal capacity.
2. Users under guardianship: Minors (from Primary to High School level) who require the intervention of a legal representative. Hericraft does not allow minors under 13 years of age to create accounts autonomously, in accordance with international standards (COPPA and GDPR) and the General Law on the Rights of Children and Adolescents in Mexico.
menores_tutor_texto: Every account of a minor in College by Hericraft must be linked to a tutor profile. This tutor is the sole legal representative before Hericraft for:
menores_tutor_texto_1: The truthfulness of the information provided.
menores_tutor_texto_2: The minor's behavior within missions and teams.
menores_tutor_texto_3: Authorization of any financial charges in College Store.
menores_validacion_texto: To ensure that consent is effectively granted by the holder of parental authority, THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY implements the enhanced validation protocol, which may include:
menores_validacion_texto_1: Two-factor validation (2FA): Confirmation via SMS or email exclusive to the tutor.
menores_validacion_texto_2: Simple digital signature: Submission of an official ID or use of digital identity services to validate kinship in high-institutional processes.
menores_validacion_texto_3: School intermediation: When access is provided by an educational institution, it acts as joint responsible party for having obtained prior parental consents.
menores_proteccion_titulo: 3.4. Data protection and privacy by design
menores_proteccion_texto: In compliance with the principle of the best interests of the child, the processing of minors' data in the ECOSYSTEM follows these strict rules:
menores_proteccion_texto_1: Nickname anonymization: The use of usernames that do not reveal the minor's real identity in public spaces of the platform is encouraged.
menores_proteccion_texto_2: Zero targeted advertising: The use of the minor's academic behavior data to generate marketing profiles or external commercial advertising is prohibited.
menores_proteccion_texto_3: Contact limitation: Interaction tools (team chat) have AI moderation filters to prevent the exchange of sensitive personal information or risky behaviors (cyberbullying/grooming).
menores_responsabilidad_texto:
Minors are not legally authorized to carry out transactions on their own.

1. Purchase filter: Any purchase attempt in College Store from an account linked to a minor will trigger a mandatory approval notification to the tutor's email/app.
2. Disclaimer of charges: Hericraft Soluciones Integrales en Educación 4.0 S.A. de C.V. is not responsible for purchases made through negligent use of parents' credit cards if they have provided their access keys to the minor. However, a period of 24 hours is offered to request cancellation of an erroneous transaction before the product enters the shipping process.

propiedad_snap_titulo: 4.2. The 'SNAP Core' as a trade secret
propiedad_snap_texto: The user acknowledges that the logical architecture, progression algorithms and data structure that make up the SNAP Ecosystem constitute a Trade Secret under the LFPPI. Its structure provides a competitive advantage to Hericraft, therefore any attempt at decompilation, reverse engineering or extraction of the algorithmic logic will be prosecuted criminally and civilly.
propiedad_licencia_titulo: 4.3. Limited use license to the user
propiedad_licencia_texto: Hericraft grants the USER a personal, temporary, revocable, non-exclusive and non-transferable license to access the contents of College by Hericraft for strictly educational purposes.
propiedad_licencia_texto_1: Scope: This license does not grant the right of distribution, public communication, transformation or commercial exploitation.
propiedad_licencia_texto_2: Term: The license automatically expires at the end of the subscription period or upon breach of these Terms and Conditions.
propiedad_prohibiciones_titulo: 4.4. Specific prohibitions on 'mining' and AI training
propiedad_prohibiciones_texto: Given the technological nature of the year 2026, the following are strictly prohibited:
propiedad_prohibiciones_texto_1: Web scraping: The use of bots, spiders or automated tools to extract content or data from the Ecosystem.
propiedad_prohibiciones_texto_2: Training of external models: The use of any Hericraft material (texts, pedagogical structures or internal AI responses) to feed, train or adjust Artificial Intelligence models other than those of THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY.
propiedad_prohibiciones_texto_3: Metadata extraction: Any attempt to capture behavioral metadata of other students for statistical or commercial purposes.
propiedad_ugc_texto: In the dynamics of "Teams" or projects of College by Hericraft, the user may upload materials (texts, images, assignments).
propiedad_ugc_texto_1: Ownership: The user retains the copyright over their original creations.
propiedad_ugc_texto_2: License to Hericraft: By uploading content, the user grants Hericraft a free, worldwide, perpetual license to use, reproduce and display such material solely for pedagogical evaluation purposes, display within the learning community and improvement of feedback algorithms.
propiedad_ugc_texto_3: Warranty of authorship: The user guarantees that they are the author of what they upload or that they have the necessary licenses, holding Hericraft harmless from any claim of plagiarism.
propiedad_marca_texto: Products sold at College Store, whether proprietary or third-party, are protected by industrial property laws. The purchase of a product does not grant the buyer rights to the brand or industrial design for mass reproduction.
propiedad_notificacion_titulo: 4.7. Infringement notification (Digital Millennium Copyright Act - DMCA Sync)
propiedad_notificacion_texto: Hericraft respects third-party intellectual property. If a user or third party believes that their work has been used in a way that constitutes infringement, they must notify it to legal@soluciones-hericraft.com with proof of ownership. Hericraft will act under "notice and takedown" protocols to expeditiously remove infringing content.
praxis_naturaleza_texto: College by Hericraft is a virtual learning environment operated under the Software as a Service (SaaS) model. The service consists of providing access to a learning architecture based on the PRAXIS TRAMA model. The user acknowledges that the platform is an educational support tool and does not replace, unless specified by express agreement with official institutions, the obligations of official validity of studies (RVOE) that correspond to third parties.
praxis_ia_titulo: 5.2. The assistive role of AI in the 'SNAP Core'
praxis_ia_texto: The SNAP Core is a pedagogical assistance architecture based on artificial intelligence that operates under the principle of "permanent human supervision". The user acknowledges and accepts the following powers and limits of this technology:
praxis_ia_texto_1: Identification of skill networks: The AI processes the student's interaction to map the development of both hard skills and soft skills, generating a progress visualization that serves as input for teacher evaluation.
praxis_ia_texto_2: Stress and operational blockage detection: The system is designed to identify behavior patterns that suggest stress, cognitive fatigue, or technical difficulty in progressing. In these cases, the AI will act only as an early warning mechanism, immediately notifying the Lead Teacher or the route administrator.
praxis_ia_texto_3: Mandatory human intervention: Any significant decision regarding the student's trajectory — including the generation of supplementary activities or modification of the learning path — will be validated and executed by the Teacher or Administrator. The AI has no authority to definitively or arbitrarily alter the user's academic status.
praxis_ia_texto_4: Review exercise management: The AI may dynamically activate or deactivate suggestions for reinforcement exercises. However, these actions are considered "Learning Proposals" and are subject to review by the supervising mentor, who may override any adjustment made by the algorithm.
praxis_ia_texto_5: No decision-making autonomy: THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY guarantees that the AI does not operate autonomously to the detriment of the user. Its function is purely analytical and supportive, ensuring that the final word in the educational process always rests with a human professional.
praxis_conducta_texto:
The platform encourages co-creation through "Teams" (collaborative work). The USER agrees to:

1. Full respect: Harassment (cyberbullying), discrimination, use of obscene language, or uploading violent/sexual content in chats and shared projects are strictly prohibited.
2. Real identity: The user must present themselves with their true identity or authorized nickname, without impersonating other students or mentors.
3. Sanctions: Failure to comply with these rules will authorize Hericraft to temporarily or permanently suspend the user's account, without refund, given the nature of the breach of community integrity.
praxis_integridad_titulo: 5.4. Academic integrity and ethical use of external tools
praxis_integridad_texto: To preserve the value of Hericraft's certifications:
praxis_integridad_texto_1: Prohibition of Plagiarism: It is forbidden to present as one's own any work, code, or text generated by third parties or external generative AIs, unless the specific mission authorizes it and proper citation is provided.
praxis_integridad_texto_2: Automated detection: Hericraft uses pattern analysis tools to detect possible academic fraud. If a breach of integrity is confirmed, the mission or module will be automatically invalidated.
praxis_certificados_texto: Skill certificates and digital badges within the SNAP system are granted only after meeting the evaluation criteria established by the College by Hericraft platform.
praxis_certificados_texto_1: Validity: These certificates have curricular validity within the ecosystem of companies allied with Hericraft, but they do not constitute an academic degree unless the program explicitly specifies so.
praxis_certificados_texto_2: Revocation: Hericraft reserves the right to revoke certificates if it is subsequently proven that the user committed academic fraud to obtain them.
praxis_disponibilidad_texto: Hericraft strives to maintain 99.9% uptime. However:
praxis_disponibilidad_texto_1: Maintenance windows: Periodic updates will be carried out that may interrupt the service, preferably during low-demand hours.
praxis_disponibilidad_texto_2: Technical requirements: It is the responsibility of the USER to have the necessary hardware, software (updated browsers), and stable internet connection to run the College by Hericraft graphical environment.
store_naturaleza_texto: Operations carried out at College Store constitute commercial purchase and sale contracts between THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY (as seller) and the USER (as buyer). These transactions are subject to current commercial legislation and consumer protection rules applicable in the user's domicile, as long as they do not contravene the public order provisions of Mexico.
store_precios_texto: Price transparency: All displayed prices include Value Added Tax (VAT) at the current rate in Mexico (16%), unless explicitly stated otherwise for international users.
store_precios_texto_1: Currencies: Prices are shown primarily in Mexican Pesos (MXN). In the case of international transactions, the exchange rate will be the one determined by the payment gateway at the time of the operation.
store_precios_texto_2: Pricing errors: If a product is shown with a manifestly erroneous price due to a technical or algorithmic error (e.g., price of $0.00 MXN), Hericraft reserves the right to cancel the order, notifying the user and refunding any payment made.
store_pago_texto: To ensure the security of the USER, payment processing is delegated to leading external providers (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, Mercado Pago).
store_pago_texto_1: No storage of banking data: Hericraft does not store or have access to the user's credit card numbers, debit card numbers or security codes (CVV).
store_pago_texto_2: Validation: All transactions are subject to anti-fraud validation. Hericraft reserves the right to request additional documentation to confirm the buyer's identity in high-value transactions.
store_envio_texto: Third-party logistics: Hericraft acts as shipper and uses certified logistics companies (e.g., FedEx, DHL, Estafeta).
store_envio_texto_1: Transfer of risk: Ownership and risk of loss of physical products are transferred to the USER at the time of delivery by the carrier at the designated address.
store_envio_texto_2: Delivery times: Delivery times are estimates. Hericraft shall not be liable for delays caused by force majeure, natural disasters or transportation strikes.
store_devoluciones_titulo: 6.5. Right of withdrawal, returns and cancellations
store_devoluciones_texto:
In compliance with Article 56 of the LFPC (Mexico) and LATAM regulations:

1. Right of withdrawal (physical products): The user has a period of 5 business days from delivery to revoke their consent, provided the product is sealed, in its original packaging and without signs of use. Return shipping costs shall be borne by the user.
2. Digital products and licenses: Due to their immediate consumption nature, the right of withdrawal does not apply once the user has started the download, accessed the content in Praxis Trama or activated the license key.
store_garantia_titulo: 6.5.3. Warranty and liability for manufacturing defects
store_garantia_texto:
The USER acknowledges that THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY acts only as a distributor of products manufactured by third parties. Therefore, the warranty policy shall be governed by the following disclaimer terms:

1. Direct replacement period (College Store window): Hericraft offers a window of 7 calendar days (after receipt) to report products with "manufacturing defects" or obvious aesthetic damage. During this period, Hericraft will directly manage the physical exchange, subject to inventory availability.
2. Manufacturer's warranty: After the first 7 days, the warranty shall be the sole and direct responsibility of the product's MANUFACTURER. The USER must enforce their rights directly with the brand's authorized service centers, under the terms and periods specified in the warranty policy included in the packaging.
3. Facilitator role: Hericraft undertakes only to provide the USER with the contact information of the manufacturer or the relevant technical support centers. Hericraft assumes no responsibility for repairs, spare parts or financial compensation once the 7‑day direct replacement window has expired.
4. Exclusions: The warranty (both Hericraft's and the manufacturer's) shall be voided if the product shows damage due to improper use, alterations, contact with liquids, drops or any handling not in accordance with the product manual instructions.
5. Logistics costs: In manufacturer warranty cases, the shipping costs of the product to the technical service center shall be borne by the USER, unless the manufacturer's policy indicates otherwise.
store_stock_texto: Hericraft updates its inventory in real time; however, if due to a system error a purchased product is not available, the user will be offered the following options:
store_stock_texto_1: Replacement with a product of similar characteristics and price.
store_stock_texto_2: Full refund of the amount paid.
store_facturacion_texto: Users requiring a legal invoice (CFDI in Mexico) must request it through the College Store invoicing portal within the calendar month in which the purchase was made. It is the user's responsibility to provide truthful and updated tax information in accordance with the current tax regime.
responsabilidad_as_is_texto: The USER accepts that access to the Digital Ecosystem (College by Hericraft and College Store) is provided "as is" and as available. THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY makes no express or implied warranties regarding the infallibility of the software, the absolute continuity of the service or that the content will satisfy the user's particular needs beyond those described in the commercial offer.
responsabilidad_exencion_ia_titulo: 7.2. Disclaimer of liability for academic and AI results
responsabilidad_exencion_ia_texto: In relation to the SNAP Core, the USER acknowledges and accepts that:
responsabilidad_exencion_ia_texto_1: Assistance, not decision: AI is a support and skills diagnosis tool; therefore, Hericraft is not liable if the AI's interpretation of stress or progress does not match the student's subjective perception.
responsabilidad_exencion_ia_texto_2: Human validation: Since all relevant pedagogical action is validated by a teacher or administrator, the ultimate responsibility for the educational intervention lies with the human professional in charge and not with Hericraft's algorithm.
responsabilidad_exencion_ia_texto_3: Success guarantee: Obtaining jobs, external academic degrees or specific skill levels is not guaranteed, as these depend on individual performance and external factors beyond the Ecosystem.
responsabilidad_terceros_titulo: 7.3. Limitation of liability for third parties and force majeure
responsabilidad_terceros_texto:
THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY shall not be liable under any circumstances for:

1. Failures in third‑party services: Interruptions in Google/Firebase servers, payment gateway outages (Stripe/PayPal) or deficiencies in logistics and courier services.
2. Zero‑day cyberattacks: Damages arising from computer attacks that, due to their novelty or sophistication, exceed the standard industry security measures in the current year (Digital force majeure).
3. Manufacturer warranties: As established in Section VI, liability for long‑term technical defects in physical products from College Store lies exclusively with the manufacturer.
responsabilidad_limite_monetario_texto: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the total liability of Hericraft to the USER for any claim arising from these terms (whether in contract, tort or otherwise) shall be limited to:
responsabilidad_limite_monetario_texto_1: For College by Hericraft: The total amount paid by the user for subscription fees in the last three (3) months prior to the event giving rise to the claim.
responsabilidad_limite_monetario_texto_2: For College Store: The purchase price of the specific product that is the subject of the dispute.
responsabilidad_usuario_texto_1: The truthfulness of the data provided.
responsabilidad_usuario_texto_2: Safeguarding their access credentials (password and two‑factor authentication).
responsabilidad_usuario_texto_3: Having the technical requirements (hardware and internet) for the proper functioning of the platform. Any damage to the user's devices arising from the use of incompatible software versions shall be their sole responsibility.
responsabilidad_indemnizacion_texto: The USER agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Hericraft Soluciones Integrales en Educación 4.0 S.A. de C.V., its officers and employees, from any claim, loss or expense (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of the misuse of the platform, violation of third‑party intellectual property rights or breach of these Terms and Conditions.
seguridad_estandares_texto: THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY declares that it has implemented administrative, technical and physical security measures to protect the integrity, confidentiality and availability of data within the Ecosystem. This includes, by way of example:
seguridad_estandares_texto_1: End‑to‑end encryption: Use of TLS/SSL (HTTPS) protocols for data transmission and AES-256 encryption for data at rest within Firebase/Google Cloud servers.
seguridad_estandares_texto_2: Database security: Implementation of Firestore Security Rules and Cloud IAM to ensure that only authorized users access their specific information.
seguridad_estandares_texto_3: Isolation of minors' data: The learning profiles of minors have additional security layers that prevent them from being indexed by external search engines.
seguridad_credenciales_titulo: 8.2. Shared responsibility and custody of credentials
seguridad_credenciales_texto:
The security of the ECOSYSTEM is a shared responsibility. The USER undertakes to:

1. Access custody: Keep their password and username confidential. Any activity carried out under their credentials will be presumed legitimate and authorized by the user.
2. Two‑Factor Authentication (2FA): Hericraft recommends (and may require for administrators and tutors) the use of 2FA. The user is responsible for maintaining access to the device linked for such verification.
3. Logout: It is the user's obligation to log out when finished using the platform, especially on shared or public devices.
seguridad_conductas_texto: Strictly prohibited, and will be reported to the Cyber Police and competent prosecutorial authorities, any attempt at:
seguridad_conductas_texto_1: Unauthorized Penetration Testing: Performing vulnerability scanning, stress testing or denial‑of‑service (DDoS) attacks.
seguridad_conductas_texto_2: Code injection: Attempts at SQL Injection or Cross‑Site Scripting (XSS) to alter the functioning of College by Hericraft or College Store.
seguridad_conductas_texto_3: Social engineering: Identity impersonation to obtain data from other students, teachers or Hericraft staff.
seguridad_breach_texto:
In accordance with international standards and Mexican regulations, if a security breach that significantly affects users' personal or financial data is detected, THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY will proceed as follows:

1. Containment and mitigation: Immediate technical action to stop the breach within the first hours of detection.
2. Crisis notification: Inform affected users and the competent authorities (INAI) within a period not exceeding 72 hours, detailing the nature of the incident and recommended measures to protect their information.
seguridad_exclusion_titulo: 8.5. Exclusion for 'zero‑day attacks' and digital force majeure
seguridad_exclusion_texto: The USER acknowledges that absolute security on the internet does not exist. THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY shall not be liable for damages arising from:
seguridad_exclusion_texto_1: Zero‑day vulnerabilities: Attacks that exploit software or hardware flaws unknown to manufacturers at the time of intrusion.
seguridad_exclusion_texto_2: Supply chain failures: Security issues originating in third‑party services (e.g., Google Cloud) that are outside Hericraft's direct control.
seguridad_exclusion_texto_3: State intervention: Actions by authorities that compromise digital infrastructure for reasons of national security or massive failures in the global internet infrastructure.
seguridad_biometria_texto: For access to the SNAP Core and exam validation, Hericraft may use behavioral biometric technologies (keystroke dynamics, mouse movement or facial recognition). The user gives their consent for this processing exclusively for security and academic identity validation purposes, ensuring that this data will never be shared for commercial purposes.
disputas_ley_texto: For all legal purposes, this contract shall be governed, interpreted and executed in accordance with the federal laws of the United Mexican States, and suppletorily by the civil and commercial legislation of the State of Aguascalientes, Mexico. The user irrevocably waives any other legislation that might correspond to them due to their present or future domicile.
disputas_conciliacion_texto:
Before initiating any administrative or judicial proceedings, the parties agree to attempt to resolve their dispute in good faith through the following protocol:

1. Complaint notification: The USER must send a detailed description of their complaint to the email address legal@soluciones-hericraft.com.
2. Negotiation period: Hericraft will have a period of 15 business days to provide a formal response and propose a solution.
3. Digital mediation: If no agreement is reached within 30 calendar days, the parties may opt for virtual mediation through recognized alternative justice centers in Aguascalientes or authorized Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platforms.
disputas_autoridades_texto: In compliance with consumer and privacy rights:
disputas_autoridades_texto_1: In matters of E‑commerce (College Store): The user may go to the Federal Consumer Protection Agency (PROFECO) in Mexico, or the equivalent authorities in their country of residence in LATAM for administrative conciliation processes.
disputas_autoridades_texto_2: In matters of personal data: The guarantor body is the National Institute for Transparency, Access to Information and Personal Data Protection (INAI).
disputas_jurisdiccion_texto:
If the dispute cannot be resolved through conciliation or mediation, the parties agree to submit exclusively to the jurisdiction of the Civil or Commercial Courts based in the city of Aguascalientes, Ags., Mexico.
Waiver of forum: The USER expressly waives any other jurisdiction or forum that might correspond to them by reason of their present or future domicile, nationality, or place of contract execution.
disputas_colectivas_texto: To the extent permitted by law, the USER agrees that any claim against Hericraft shall be brought on an individual basis. The user waives the right to participate as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class action or representative proceeding against THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY or its affiliates.
disputas_divisibilidad_texto: If any provision of these Terms and Conditions is declared null, illegal or unenforceable by a competent court, such nullity shall not affect the validity of the remaining clauses, which shall retain their binding force and full effect.
disputas_idioma_texto: These terms may be translated into other languages for the user's convenience. However, in the event of any discrepancy, contradiction or legal interpretation, the Spanish version shall be the only valid and prevailing version for all legal purposes.
modificaciones_texto: Hericraft reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will become effective 24 hours after their publication on the website. Continued use of the platform implies acceptance of the new T&C.
